label: ⏳ Changepoint detection
description: Find rows where the time series shifts in mean. Uses a rolling-window CUSUM approach — distribution-free, no scipy required. Returns a `is_changepoint` boolean column flagging the rows where the change occurred plus a `cusum` column for the test statistic so you can plot it.

threshold.label: Detection threshold
threshold.help: CUSUM threshold (in σ). Higher = fewer detected changes. Default 5σ flags only large shifts.
